claim_scope: The complete 13-conjugacy-class rational homology character for the 216 automorphisms of the labeled Pappus graph, including fixed-space dimension zero and complex character inner product two.
integrity: Exact finite scripts establish exhaustive automorphism enumeration, acyclic finite Morse matching and character formulas; independently written direct signed-trace and mod-two checks were executed. No independent external mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sphere-wedge homotopy and C3 subgroup character were already obtained in prior published research. The distinct new claim is the full 216-element character; irreducible degrees, integral module and equivariant homotopy decomposition remain undetermined. Priority cannot be certified against unindexed literature.
title: Complete automorphism character of the Pappus independence complex
